title.en: Let's get together — meet & greet before Pujo

body.en:
Let’s get together! ❤️

As we take this Pujo forward, we’d love to bring together everyone who would like to be a part of it — Bengalis of Nallagandla, our friends from ACS, and everyone else who wants to join us.

Let’s meet over cha, shingara, misti & adda, share ideas and get to know each other as we come together to make this Pujo a truly collective celebration.

Everyone is welcome!

📅 Friday, 2nd October 2026 | 5–7 PM
📍 NIRUSA Banquet, Lingampally
Beside Santa Maria School, 5th Floor above Ratnadeep Supermarket

image.alt: Parbon Sanskritik Samity flyer: "Let's get together! Cha, shingara, mishti & a little adda before Pujo begins" — an informal meet & greet on 2nd October, 5 PM to 7 PM, at NIRUSA Banquet, Lingampally, with a clay cup of tea, shingaras and mishti.

body.en:
Parbon Sanskritik Samity invites you all to come together and be a part of Durga Puja 2026. ❤️

We are taking this Pujo forward with the support of our community, friends and well-wishers, and we request your support as we come together to make this celebration truly special.

For those who would like to contribute, the details are shared in the poster.

Durga Maa ki Joi 🙏
